units.source_text: 小女公子听他们唱和，全然不懂，只管跳跳蹦蹦地戏耍。

en.t: The little princess listened to their exchange of songs, but understood nothing at all, and simply skipped and bounced about as she played.

units.source_text: 紫姬看了觉得非常可爱，对明石姬的醋意也消减了。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki saw her, she found her utterly adorable, and her jealousy toward Lady Akashi also began to fade.

units.source_text: 她推想明石姬一定非常想念这孩子。

en.t: She imagined that Lady Akashi must miss this child terribly.

units.source_text: 倘使换了她自己，该是何等伤心呵！

en.t: If she herself were in that position, how heartbroken she would be!

units.source_text: 她对这孩子注视了一会，抱她到怀里，摸出自己那个莹洁可爱的乳房来，给她含在口中，以为戏耍。

en.t: She gazed at the child for a while, took her into her arms, drew out her own fair and lovely breast, and let the child take it into her mouth as though it were a game.

units.source_text: 旁人看了觉得这光景真是有趣！

en.t: Those nearby watched and thought the scene was truly charming.

units.source_text: 侍女们互相告道：“夫人怎么没有生育？

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting said to one another, "Why has our lady never borne a child?

units.source_text: 这孩子倘是自己生的，多好呢！”

en.t: How wonderful it would be if this child had been born to her herself!"
